scripts.build: node -e "const webpack = require('webpack'); const pkg = require('./package.json'); const config = pkg.webpackConfig; const devServer = config.devServer; delete config.devServer; config.output.path = require('path').resolve(config.output.path); config.module.rules.forEach(rule => { rule.test = new RegExp(rule.test); if (rule.exclude) rule.exclude = new RegExp(rule.exclude); }); config.plugins = [new (require('copy-webpack-plugin'))({ patterns: pkg.copyWebpackPatterns })]; if (process.argv.includes('--serve')) { config.mode = 'development'; config.entry.bundle.unshift('webpack-hot-middleware/client?reload=true'); config.plugins.push(new webpack.HotModuleReplacementPlugin()); const compiler = webpack(config); const express = require('express'); const app = express(); app.use(require('compression')()); app.use(require('webpack-dev-middleware')(compiler, { publicPath: '/' })); app.use(require('webpack-hot-middleware')(compiler)); app.use(express.static(config.output.path)); app.listen(devServer.port, 'localhost', () => console.log('http://localhost:' + devServer.port)).on('error', error => { console.error(error); compiler.close(() => process.exit(1)); }); } else { const compiler = webpack(config); compiler.run((error, stats) => { if (error) console.error(error); if (stats) console.log(stats.toString({ colors: true })); compiler.close(closeError => { if (closeError) console.error(closeError); if (error || closeError || stats.hasErrors()) process.exitCode = 1; }); }); }" --
